summary: The scalar estimate and all selected-core conclusions are proved without errors or gaps. The reciprocal-odd-root classification is exhaustive for at most four entries, its quantitative separation and constants are correct, and the five-entry obstruction has exactly zero defect and positive distinguished score contribution. The lattice argument applies the scalar estimate to the original endpoint class with the selected endpoint multipliers, counts at most six unordered pairs per class, and charges each exceptional center once. The selected-row definitions agree with the supplied predecessor conventions, while all assertions requiring occupancy four are established directly. The original-law moment identities, deleted-pair multiplicities, energy lower bound, and all stated boundary cases are valid.
